description: Daily values of one indicator over the chosen period: date, value, zone, methodology version. Without a key the last year is served, the full history needs a key; when the period was cut, the answer carries depth_limited. Good for showing how the indicator moved, but it is the platform's estimate, not an exchange series.

spec_id.description: Indicator identifier from list_indicators, e.g. afgi.
